title: Kadal Deck frontmatter
description: Frontmatter for deck.mdx. Validate the top block (headmatter) against #/$defs/headmatter and every other slide's block against #/$defs/slide.

layout.description: The slide's layout (see layouts). Default: cover for the first slide, default after.

class.description: Extra CSS classes on the slide.

id.description: A stable id: `#/<id>` links here and <Link to> finds it.

generated.description: Set by the compiler on a slide it adds ("credits", for `credits: true`); tools that count the author's slides skip it. Not for decks to write.

title.description: The title the table of contents and search use (default: the first heading).

level.description: Heading level for the table of contents (default: the first heading's depth).

hide.description: Leave the slide out of the talk (still in the file).

visibility.description: "hidden" leaves it out; "uncounted" shows it without a number.

transition.description: This slide's transition (see transitions): a built-in, or a name from the headmatter's `transitions` / `registerTransition` / your CSS. `zoom-in fade-out` names each half.

autoAnimate.description: Animate matching elements (same text or data-id) from the previous auto-animate slide.

autoAnimateId.description: Only auto-animate between slides with the same id.

autoAnimateEasing.description: reveal.js compatible: the CSS easing of the auto-animate into this slide, over the deck's.

autoAnimateDuration.description: reveal.js compatible: seconds the auto-animate into this slide takes, over the deck's.

autoAnimateUnmatched.description: reveal.js compatible: whether this slide's elements with no match fade in, over the deck's.

autoSlide.description: Milliseconds before this slide advances on its own.

clicks.description: Force the number of click steps.

clicksStart.description: The step the slide opens at.

preload.description: Load the slide's module ahead of time (default true).

timing.description: Seconds planned for this slide (the presenter's pacing timer).

state.description: Adds state-<name> classes while the slide shows (CSS hooks).

colorScheme.description: Force light or dark tokens on this slide (dark background under a light theme).

zoom.description: Scale the slide's content (0.8 fits more).

background.description: A background: a registered name (aurora…), a colour, a gradient, an image or video path/URL, or { component, ...props } / { image, size, position, opacity } / { iframe, interactive } / { fill | tint }.

backgroundGradient.description: A CSS gradient behind the slide.

backgroundImage.description: An image URL behind the slide.

backgroundSize.description: CSS background-size for the image (also the image layouts).

backgroundVideo.description: A video URL behind the slide.

backgroundVideoLoop.description: Loop the background video (the default); false plays it once.

backgroundIframe.description: A page (iframe URL) behind the slide.

backgroundInteractive.description: Let the background page take input.

image.description: The image for the image, image-left and image-right layouts.

url.description: The page for the iframe, iframe-left and iframe-right layouts.

poster.description: A picture that stands in for the iframe in print, previews and while it loads.

posterUrl.description: Capture the poster from this address instead of `url`.

posterWait.description: Milliseconds to let the page settle before the poster capture, counted once its network has gone quiet (default 5000).

terms.description: false: link no glossary terms automatically on this slide; { skip: [GIS] } leaves some out.

src.description: Include the slides of another .mdx file here (a frontmatter-only slide). `#2-5`, `#1,3,5-7` or `#4-` includes only those slides (1-based); the slide's other keys merge into the first of them.

say.description: What the narrator says on this slide instead of its notes (`[click]` splits it into steps); an empty string keeps it silent.

narration.description: false: the narrator says nothing here (the slide dwells as `narration.silent` says). In the headmatter, false switches narration off for the deck.

dragPos.description: Named positions for `<Drag pos="name">` / `<DragArrow pos="name">`: "x,y,w,h[,rotation]" in stage pixels, `_` for an automatic height. `kadal-deck dev` writes them when an element is dragged.

layout.description: The slide's layout (see layouts). Default: cover for the first slide, default after.

class.description: Extra CSS classes on the slide.

id.description: A stable id: `#/<id>` links here and <Link to> finds it.

generated.description: Set by the compiler on a slide it adds ("credits", for `credits: true`); tools that count the author's slides skip it. Not for decks to write.

title.description: The deck's title (browser tab, table of contents, publish).

level.description: Heading level for the table of contents (default: the first heading's depth).

hide.description: Leave the slide out of the talk (still in the file).

visibility.description: "hidden" leaves it out; "uncounted" shows it without a number.

transition.description: Slide transition (see transitions), or one of your own from `transitions` (or CSS on `.deck-stage[data-transition="name"]` setting `--deck-anim-in` / `--deck-anim-out`).

autoAnimate.description: Allow auto-animate between slides that set `autoAnimate`.

autoAnimateId.description: Only auto-animate between slides with the same id.

autoAnimateUnmatched.description: Fade in elements without a match.

autoSlide.description: Milliseconds between automatic steps; 0: only the slides that set their own, false: none, not even those.

clicks.description: Force the number of click steps.

clicksStart.description: The step the slide opens at.

preload.description: Load the slide's module ahead of time (default true).

timing.description: Seconds planned for this slide (the presenter's pacing timer).

state.description: Adds state-<name> classes while the slide shows (CSS hooks).

zoom.description: Alt+click zooms into a point; Esc zooms back out.

background.description: A background: a registered name (aurora…), a colour, a gradient, an image or video path/URL, or { component, ...props } / { image, size, position, opacity } / { iframe, interactive } / { fill | tint }.

backgroundGradient.description: A CSS gradient behind the slide.

backgroundImage.description: An image URL behind the slide.

backgroundSize.description: CSS background-size for the image (also the image layouts).

backgroundVideo.description: A video URL behind the slide.

backgroundVideoLoop.description: Loop the background video (the default); false plays it once.

backgroundIframe.description: A page (iframe URL) behind the slide.

backgroundInteractive.description: Let the background page take input.

image.description: The image for the image, image-left and image-right layouts.

url.description: The page for the iframe, iframe-left and iframe-right layouts.

poster.description: A picture that stands in for the iframe in print, previews and while it loads.

posterUrl.description: Capture the poster from this address instead of `url`.

posterWait.description: Milliseconds to let the page settle before the poster capture, counted once its network has gone quiet (default 5000).

terms.description: false: link no glossary terms automatically on this slide; { skip: [GIS] } leaves some out.

src.description: Include the slides of another .mdx file here (a frontmatter-only slide). `#2-5`, `#1,3,5-7` or `#4-` includes only those slides (1-based); the slide's other keys merge into the first of them.

say.description: What the narrator says on this slide instead of its notes (`[click]` splits it into steps); an empty string keeps it silent.

narration.description: Narration (autoplay rehearsal: the notes read aloud, each `[click]` part at its step, the pages turning by themselves): { enabled ("auto" = when some slide has notes; false turns it off), engine ("auto" · "baked" · "kokoro" · "browser" · "silent"), voice (Kokoro id, default af_heart), rate (0.5–3), gap (ms between steps), silent (a slide without notes: "estimate", "skip" or ms), model (Hugging Face id), dtype ("auto" · fp32 · fp16 · q8 · q4 · q4f16) }. The bar is in the presenter view; on the deck, `?narrate` or R. Kokoro needs `kokoro-js` installed (`kadal-deck narrate --setup`); without it the browser's own voice reads. `kadal-deck narrate` bakes clips.

dragPos.description: Named positions for `<Drag pos="name">` / `<DragArrow pos="name">`: "x,y,w,h[,rotation]" in stage pixels, `_` for an automatic height. `kadal-deck dev` writes them when an element is dragged.

date.description: When the talk is given, as YYYY-MM-DD. The deck doesn't show it; listings sort by it.

width.description: The authored size; the stage scales uniformly to fit any viewport.

height.description: The authored height in px; with width, the stage every screen scales.

margin.description: Fraction of the viewport left empty around the stage. 0 by default: a 16:9 window shows the slide edge to edge, any other shape gets bars on two sides — the content never reflows.

minScale.description: Smallest scale the stage may shrink to.

maxScale.description: Largest scale the stage may grow to.

disableLayout.description: reveal.js compatible: no scaling or centring; the slides fill the page at its own size and you style them responsively (bring your own layout). Default false.

controls.description: Show the navigation arrows; "speaker" shows them only in the presenter view.

controlsTutorial.description: Hint at vertical slides the first time.

progress.description: The progress bar along the bottom.

slideNumber.description: Show slide numbers: true, or a format — "h.v", "h/v", "c" (current), "c/t" (current/total). reveal.js compatible: deck.config.ts may pass a function of the slide ({ h, v, click, index, total, id }) returning one string or three ([h, ".", v]).

hash.description: Keep the URL hash in step with the slide.

history.description: Push a history entry per slide (Back walks the slides).

respondToHashChanges.description: reveal.js compatible: a change to the URL hash (a link, the address bar) moves the deck. Default true.

keyboardCondition.description: reveal.js compatible: when the deck takes keys. null (default): always; "focused": only while the deck has focus (a deck embedded in a page). deck.config.ts may pass a function of the KeyboardEvent instead, true letting the key through.

focusBodyOnPageVisibilityChange.description: reveal.js compatible: when the tab becomes visible again, take focus back from an embedded frame so the keys reach the deck. Default true.

touch.description: Swipe navigation. A touch that starts inside `data-prevent-swipe` (or on media controls) keeps its gesture; `rtl` mirrors the horizontal swipes.

loop.description: Wrap from the last slide to the first.

navigationMode.description: "default", "linear" (arrows walk every slide) or "grid" (columns stay aligned).

fragments.description: Clicks/fragments on; off shows every step at once.

fragmentInURL.description: Include the click step in the hash.

embedded.description: The deck lives inside another page.

postMessage.description: reveal.js compatible: a page that frames the deck can drive it with reveal's postMessage calls (`{ method, args }`). Default true.

postMessageEvents.description: reveal.js compatible: post the deck's events (slide changed, fragment shown …) to the framing page, as reveal's `{ namespace: "reveal", eventName, state }`. Default false.

showNotes.description: Print notes with the slides: true (in a box) or "separate-page".

autoPlayMedia.description: Autoplay media on every slide (null = per element).

preloadIframes.description: reveal.js compatible: null (default): an iframe with `data-preload` loads within viewDistance and the rest when their slide shows; true: every iframe loads within viewDistance; false: only when its slide shows.

autoAnimateStyles.description: reveal.js compatible: the CSS properties auto-animate morphs between matched elements. Default reveal's list: opacity, color, background-color, padding, font-size, line-height, letter-spacing, border-width, border-color, border-radius, outline, outline-offset.

autoAnimateMatcher.description: reveal.js compatible, deck.config.ts only: a function (from, to) of the two slides' elements returning the pairs to morph ([{ from, to }]), in place of matching by text and data-id. null (default): the built-in matching.

autoSlideMethod.description: reveal.js compatible: the step auto-slide takes, by name. "next" (default) walks every click step and slide, down a vertical stack before going right. reveal takes a function here; a name works in YAML.

defaultTiming.description: Seconds per slide for the pacing timer, or null.

totalTime.description: Total seconds for the pacing timer, or null.

previewLinks.description: Open every outside link in the lightbox. A link with `data-preview-link="false"` (or `data-no-preview`) opens as a link.

parallaxBackgroundImage.description: reveal.js compatible: one large image behind every slide that shifts a little with each slide (a path in public/ or a URL). Empty (default): none.

parallaxBackgroundSize.description: reveal.js compatible: the parallax image's CSS background-size, e.g. "2100px 900px". Empty (default): the image's own size.

parallaxBackgroundHorizontal.description: reveal.js compatible: pixels the parallax image moves per horizontal slide. null (default): worked out from the image and slide count.

parallaxBackgroundVertical.description: reveal.js compatible: pixels the parallax image moves per vertical slide. null (default): worked out from the image and slide count.

viewDistance.description: Slides kept mounted on either side.

scrollLayout.description: reveal.js compatible: the scroll view's page. "compact" (default): each slide as wide as the viewport, as tall as its aspect ratio makes it; "full": each slide fills the viewport height, letterboxed, as reveal does by default.

scrollSnap.description: Scroll snapping in the scroll view.

scrollActivationWidth.description: Viewport width under which the scroll view switches on by itself; 0 (the default) never does — a phone gets the same stage, letterboxed, and `?view=scroll` stays an explicit choice.

theme.description: The theme: a built-in (minimal, rla, stack, none), a package (`seriph` finds @kadal/theme-seriph, then kadal-theme-seriph, then a package of that name), a folder (`./theme`), or a class your own CSS defines (.theme-<name>). The Vite plugin imports a package's CSS and module for you; `kadal-deck theme eject` copies it into the deck.

themes.description: The themes the deck ships besides `theme`, first in its theme menu and in this order: built-ins, packages or folders, resolved like `theme` (the Vite plugin imports their CSS), or classes main.tsx's CSS defines. The menu then offers every first-party theme not listed (seventeen in all), each loaded only when picked; a list orders the menu, it does not narrow it.

pdfSeparateFragments.description: A page per click step in print/PDF.

pdfMaxPagesPerSlide.description: Pages a tall slide may spill onto.

wakeLock.description: Keep the screen awake while presenting.

lineNumbers.description: Line numbers on every code block.

autoFit.description: Scale a slide whose content overflows so it fits (measured after render).

monacoTypes.description: Where `{monaco}` editors get the types of the packages they import (monaco/types.ts): "auto" (the deck's installed ones in a build, else the CDN), "local", "cdn" or "none".

monacoPackages.description: Packages the editors know: their types are acquired up front, and `{monaco-run}` imports them at these versions. A list (`["zod", "lodash-es@4"]`) or a map (`{ zod: "^3.23" }`).

monacoTypesIgnore.description: Packages never to fetch types for.

monacoRunImports.description: Where `{monaco-run}` resolves a bare import (`import { z } from "zod"`): a CDN base (`https://esm.sh`, the default) or a template with `{name}`, `{version}` and `{path}`; false keeps bare imports an error.

live.description: Live room: the backend base (same origin `/api` on the host), or null for an offline deck. `verify` is a host page that checks a viewer (Turnstile) and sends them back with a pass — how a host that serves decks sandboxed keeps the check, since Turnstile can't run in an opaque origin. Set by the host (`window.__KADAL_DECK__.verify`), never by a deck.

remote.description: The phone remote without a room or a dev server: `relay` is the WebSocket address of a `kadal-deck relay` (`wss://…`), where a build's presenter view and phone page meet — a deck on GitHub Pages, Netlify, S3 or any static host. `?relay=wss://…` on the presenter view's address does the same for that tab. Null (the default): no relay. A deck with a room pairs through the room; `kadal-deck dev` through the dev server.

drawings.description: Drawing: { enabled: true | false | "dev", persist: true (browser storage) | "files" (drawings/<slide>.svg beside deck.mdx, written on `kadal-deck dev`, bundled into the build, printed into every export) | false, presenterOnly, syncAll, perClick (a stroke shows from the click step it was drawn on) }. Files in drawings/ are always shown under the live strokes.

glossary.description: Term cards. The runtime reads `delay` and `sync`; the rest steers the compiler, which sees the headmatter only — set those there. `glossary: false` or a path are shorthands.

reactions.description: Audience reactions in the live room.

qa.description: Audience questions in the live room.

polls.description: Polls and quizzes in the live room.

audienceNotes.description: Show every slide's notes to anyone on the audience page (after the talk, for instance).

slug.description: The deck's slug on the host, from the Vite base — decks/<slug>.

badge.description: Show the "Made with Kadal Deck" link in the corner (set by the host, see `withHostOverride`).

ads.description: Frame the first and last slides with the host's ads (set by the host, see `withHostOverride` and core/ads.ts). Only the play view shows them.

download.description: A Download button beside the theme menu. `true` offers the PDF that `kadal-deck build --download` puts beside the deck (`deck.pdf`), or the browser exporter (/export) when there is none; a URL links that file instead. A host may switch it off, or on, for the decks it serves (`window.__KADAL_DECK__.download`). See core/download.ts.

fonts.description: Web fonts: Google Fonts families as written (`["Inter:wght@400;600"]`), or an object — `{ sans, heading, serif, mono, weights, italic, provider: google|bunny|none, local, fallbacks }` — which also points the theme's font tokens at them (theming/fonts.ts).

seoMeta.description: The link preview and search tags (core/head.ts), by unhead's names: `ogImage` (`auto` photographs slide 1 into og-image.png at build; a path or URL uses that), `ogUrl`, `ogTitle`, `ogDescription`, `twitterCard`, `twitterSite`, `canonical`, `themeColor`, and any other key as a meta tag of its own. Written into the built index.html.

lang.description: The page's language: `<html lang>` and og:locale. Empty leaves index.html's.

favicon.description: The tab icon: a file in public/ (`/logo.svg`) or a URL. The PWA's icon, when it is local.

pwa.description: `kadal-deck build` makes the deck an installable web app that presents offline: a web manifest, icons, and a service worker that precaches the build (vite/pwa.ts). Never in dev; `kadal-deck publish` leaves it out unless `--pwa`. An object sets { name, shortName, themeColor, backgroundColor, display }.

bundleRemoteAssets.description: At build, download the remote images, media, fonts (Google Fonts' CSS and its files) and CSS `url()`s the deck names into dist/remote-assets/ and point the deck at the copies, so it presents with no network (vite/remote-assets.ts). Cached in .kadal-deck/cache.

defaults.description: Frontmatter every slide gets unless it sets the key itself, e.g. `{ layout: center, transition: fade }`. A theme's defaults sit beneath it.

plantUmlServer.description: The PlantUML server ```plantuml fences render with: `<server>/svg/<encoded source>`.

comark.description: Comark (formerly MDC) syntax in the slides: `:badge[New]{tone="good"}`, `[text]{.class}`, `::callout{type="warn"}` … `::` blocks with `#slot` sections (compiler/remark-comark.ts).

notesAutoRuby.description: Words in the speaker notes and their reading, shown as ruby: `{ 日本語: "ni hon go" }`.

katex.description: KaTeX options for every formula, e.g. `{ macros: { "\\RR": "\\mathbb{R}" } }`.

mermaid.description: Mermaid configuration for every diagram (theme, themeVariables, look, flowchart…).

transitions.description: Named custom transitions: `{ flip: { in: "flip-in", out: "flip-out", back: {…} } }`, the keyframes defined in the theme's CSS or a `<style global>` (core/transitions.ts).

addons.description: Addon packages: `@kadal/addon-<name>`, `kadal-addon-<name>`, a package name or a folder.

themeConfig.description: The theme's knobs: each key becomes a `--theme-<kebab-key>` custom property on the deck root (`primary: "#0f766e"` → `--theme-primary`), over the theme's own defaults.

layers.description: Where the global and slide layers draw besides the deck, print and export.

credits.description: Media credits (credits/model.ts): `true` collects every attributed GIF, sticker, meme, emoji set, icon set and credited image the slides use, puts a "Credits" slide before the last slide (`slide: "end"`: after it), and a small link to it in the corner of every other slide (`footer: false`: none). `title` names the slide and the link. Once compiled, the value is the collected credits (`ResolvedCredits`) that `<Credits />` draws.

timer.description: The presenter's timer: "stopwatch" counts up, "countdown" counts down from `duration`. Both pause, resume and reset, show a progress bar when the talk has a length, and go into overtime past it; the pacing badge (ahead/behind) works with either.

duration.description: How long the talk is, in seconds once read: `30min`, `1h`, `1h30m`, `90s`, `25:00`, or a number of minutes. The countdown runs from it and the progress bar fills to it; pacing spreads it over the slides when there is no `totalTime`. Null: the planned length is `totalTime`, else the slides' `timing` added up, else (for a countdown) thirty minutes.

contextMenu.description: The right-click menu on the slides: true (always), false (never), "dev" (only under `kadal-deck dev`) or "build" (only in a built deck). Shift + right-click always gives the browser's own menu.

aspectRatio.description: With canvasWidth, sets width and height (16/9 = 1.777…).

canvasWidth.description: The stage width used with aspectRatio.

mdc.description: The older spelling of `comark` (MDC is Comark's former name).

remoteAssets.description: Another spelling of bundleRemoteAssets (true or "build"; "dev" does nothing).
